stage1.impression: A warm, believable deep-plan bar interior: board ceiling, fir beams, record wall, polished concrete floor with nice soft reflections, and two small red speakers glowing on a far stage. But it does not read as a photograph from the kerb: there is no glass, no reflection, no shopfront steel, and the window lettering is a flat, opaque, razor-edged pink 'RF' pasted over the top-left corner like a graphic overlay. The hero speakers are tiny and murky, the pendant is a blown white dot, and as a 'specific place' it reads more as a generic warm wine bar than as Planet EARF; a magazine would not run it as is.

blocking_9: The shopfront itself must be in the picture: blackened-steel frame, glass with faint reflections of the street lamps, and the frosted lightbox legible as a lightbox, so the frame reads as taken from the pavement through glass
The etched name must read as acid-etched glass (translucent, softly lit, interior visible through it), not an opaque flat overlay with a 1 px edge
The Ember pair must read at a glance as the hero: speaker regions lum_median >= 55 with visible acrylic glow, larger in frame
No feature-less clipped practicals: the Dome pendant must show form (clip_pct < 15 in its box)
Some sign of life and atmosphere (haze in the light pools, a coat, glasses legible from outside)

defects.what: Window etched name renders as a solid, opaque cream-pink fill with a 1 px hard edge (edge step -108 over 1 px); occludes the record wall, no glass translucency, cropped to 'RF' so it reads as a graphic overlay, not etching
No glass reflections anywhere: no street lamps, no kerb, no shopfront mirrored in the glass; the view reads as an interior shot with the camera inside, contradicting the 'from the kerb' brief
Only one dark vertical (steel mullion?) visible, lum_median 15, reading as a column in the room rather than a blackened-steel shopfront; no transom, sill or frame
Ember speakers small (about 40 x 45 px at proof scale) and dim: lum_median 41.5 and 39.2, under the 45 target; the acrylic reads as red boxes with a grey disc, not as glowing tinted cast acrylic
Dome pendant is a featureless blown white disc: clip_pct 36 %, neutral white (202/194/188), no tint or dome form
Right-wall panel (the lightbox?) reads as a framed print on a wall, lum_median 130, not as a frosted lightbox with a fogged dancing figure
Record wall spines smeared/soft, denoiser smear, no individual sleeves legible
Green banquette on the altar stage competes with the red speakers as a second saturated colour (fixed by the design's zone, but in this frame it splits the eye)

evidence.measured: Only one dark vertical at x 200-235 (lum_median 15); no frame members at top or bottom; no reflections; etched name cropped to 'RF'
